name: Kevin from Accounting
blurb: Suit and tie on a scooter, weirdly vicious.

meta.notes: M1 box rival (ai-1). The tone guide makes him a grudge-keeper; grudges arrive in M4, so in M1 he is a heavy hitter: brutal up close (kicks a lot), always from your left, never takes a risk in traffic. He rides the starter bike until his scooter exists.
